entities.name: Battle of Megheddon Defile
entities.description: A battle of the Thran-Phyrexian War c. -5000 AR.

entities.name: Megheddon Defile
entities.description: Mountain pass leading to the desert plain by Halcyon, destroyed in the battle.

entities.name: Thran Alliance
entities.description: Army of humans, dwarves, elves, viashino and minotaurs opposing Yawgmoth.

entities.name: Yawgmoth
entities.description: Leader of the Halcyte forces who seized the Null Sphere.

entities.name: Phyrexians
entities.description: Yawgmoth's first Phyrexians, people mutated in Phyrexia.

entities.name: Null Sphere
entities.description: Artifact monitoring, communication and control device that Yawgmoth took over.

entities.name: Curtisworthy
entities.description: Dwarven commander who died as the Defile was obliterated.

entities.name: Thran-Phyrexian War
entities.description: The war the battle belongs to.

entities.name: Battle of the Null Sphere
entities.description: Battle in which Yawgmoth installed himself as master of the Sphere.

events.summary: The Thran Alliance's armies come through the defile to the desert plain across from Halcyon, where Yawgmoth lies in wait.
events.quote: Yawgmoth had his forces lying in wait

events.summary: Yawgmoth's forces ambush the Alliance; the Alliance sends mantis soldiers against his behemoths.
events.quote: The battle started as an ambush

events.summary: Yawgmoth installs himself as master of the Null Sphere in the Battle of the Null Sphere.
events.quote: he installed himself as master of the Sphere

events.summary: On the third day the Alliance is trapped behind walls of bodies, unable to retreat or break through.
events.quote: They could not retreat into the defile.

events.summary: Yawgmoth seizes the Alliance's artifacts, turning them on their makers.
events.quote: causing them to turn on their makers

events.summary: The Null Sphere drops a stonecharger that obliterates the Defile as Curtisworthy dies.

relations.quote: while Yawgmoth had his Halcyte Guard
Yawgmoth's ranks tore into the Thran Alliance's army at the foot of the defile
